caption: Reality check on AI planning: you can miss priorities even with many prompts. This carousel gives a simple 5-prompt workflow to diagnose, prioritise, map, check, and refine. Which prompt will you try first this week? #AIforProductivity #ProductivityTips #Entrepreneurship

slides.title: the strongest hook.
slides.body: Reality check: AI planning leaks time. Five prompts fix it: diagnose gaps, prioritise impact, map a week, check feasibility, refine.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose gaps
slides.body: Diagnose gaps in your plan: identify 2 missing tasks and their impact. Output: bullet list of 2 items: task, impact.

slides.title: 2. Prioritise impact
slides.body: Improve prioritisation: score tasks by impact and effort, then rank top 3 with recommended next action. Output: ranked list.

slides.title: 3. Apply to week
slides.body: Apply to a sample week: map top 3 tasks to daily blocks. Output: day-by-day list with task, block length, goal.

slides.title: 4. Feasibility check
slides.body: Check feasibility: estimate time and blockers for each task. Output: bullet list of 3 risks with simple mitigations.

slides.title: 5. Refine into workflow
slides.body: Refine into a reusable workflow: create a simple weekly planning checklist with diagnosis, prioritisation, execution, and review steps.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Master weekly planning with AI: you decide faster, finish more, reduce firefighting. Save this for later and follow @naelbuildingbig.
